question: Angle subtended by a chord PQ on the centre of a circle is 180 degree. If length of chord PQ is 54 cm, then what will be the diameter of this circle?
solution:
Given:

The length of the chord is 54 cm.

Concept used:

If an angle subtended by a chord on the circumference of a circle is 180 degrees, then the chord is the circle's diameter. 

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f389b9e6ffe42f82e59c7428cd0bd21f1f5b2739389ba05bd7e23e8781309b7f.png] 

If an angle subtended by a chord on the circumference of a circle is 180 degrees, then the chord is the circle's diameter.

So the length of the diameter is 54 cm
